item.title: Slash &amp; Duff McKagan Reunite with Ex-GN'R Members Steven Adler &amp; Gilby Clarke at Benefit Gig
item.description: Slash and Duff McKagan reunited with former Guns N' Roses members Steven Adler and Gilby Clarke at the "Rock for Jennifer - Loud and Legendary" benefit concert.

item.title: Flea Covers Frank Ocean's "Thinkin Bout You" on Fallon
item.description: Flea stopped by The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon to perform his cover of Frank Ocean's "Thinkin Bout You," which appears on his upcoming album Honora.

item.title: JAY-Z Thinks Kendrick Lamar and Drake's Rap Beef Went "Too Far"
item.description: JAY-Z has said Kendrick Lamar and Drake's rap beef went "too far," questioning if battling is still a necessary pillar of hip-hop culture.

item.title: Original Deftones Bassist Kicked Out of Band's Show for "Being Too Aggressive in the Pit"
item.description: Original Deftones bassist Dominic Garcia recently went to see his former band play a hometown gig in Sacramento, California, and was kicked out of the show.

item.title: Pixies Announce 2026 US Tour
item.description: Pixies have announced a brief US tour taking place in September 2026 in celebration of their 40th anniversary as a band.

item.title: Alice Cooper Recruits New Guitarist Anna Cara for 2026 Tour Dates
item.description: Alice Cooper, legendary hard rock and heavy metal musician, has announced a new live guitarist, the 22-year old Anna Cara, for his upcoming 2026 tour dates.

item.title: of Montreal Announce New Album aethermead, Share Forceful Lead Single "When"
item.description: of Montreal's astounding 20th studio album is both a breakup record and an "account of personal rebirth" for mastermind Kevin Barnes.

item.title: James Cody Lollar, Musician Known as GOST, Has Died
item.description: James Cody Lollar, the dark-synthwave artist known as GOST, has passed away. The sad news was posted on the musician's social pages.

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Announces New Album you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love
item.description: Olivia Rodrigo has announced her new album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love, out June 12th via Geffen Records.

item.title: Ex-Turnstile Guitarist Charged with Attempting to Murder Singer's Father
item.description: Former Turnstile guitarist Brady Ebert allegedly attempted to run over singer Brendan Yates' 79-year-old father with a car.

item.title: *NSYNC Choreographer Sues Sony Music for Letting Deadpool Dance His "Bye Bye Bye" Routine
item.description: Darrin Henson claims he owns the copyright for his choreography, which won an MTV Music Video Award.

item.title: Pooh Shiesty Arrested and Charged with Kidnapping Gucci Mane
item.description: Rapper Pooh Shiesty has been arrested and charged with robbing and kidnapping his former label boss, Gucci Mane.

item.title: Courtney Love Recalls Being “Trafficked” by the Yakuza, Forced to Strip in Japan
item.description: Courtney Love has described her experience being "trafficked" by the Yakuza as a teenager and forced to strip in Japan as a "delightful" time.

item.title: Bo Lueders, Harm's Way Guitarist & HardLore Podcast Host, Dead at 38
item.description: Bo Lueders, co-founding guitarist of Harm's Way and co-host of hardcore podcast HardLore, has passed away at the age of 38.

item.title: Bush Bring Atmospheric Ambiance to NPR's Tiny Desk Concert
item.description: Post-grunge band Bush recently played NPR's Tiny Concert Desk series, performing rearrangements of their material that pivoted toward the atmospheric.
